purchases_intro: All of your purchases and addons over time. If you have a partner, their purchases appear here too (excluding gifts for you). Edit any row to record pricing and notes, which stay private to you.
purchases_chart_by_recipient_description: Per recipient, stacked by gift vs. addon.
purchases_chart_over_time_description: Per month, stacked by gift vs. addon.
purchases_co_gifter_tooltip: Your even share of this co-gifted purchase.
purchases_edit_error_claim_not_yours: You can't edit someone else's claim.
purchases_edit_error_addon_not_yours: You can't edit someone else's gift.
purchases_edit_description: Update the cost, tracking, and notes for this purchase.
purchases_edit_notes_placeholder: Add any notes about this purchase...
purchases_edit_attachments_help: Keep receipts, gift receipts, or order confirmations handy for returns and reimbursements. Accepts images (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP) and PDFs.
purchases_edit_uploads_disabled: Uploads are disabled on this server.
purchases_split_error_exceeds_total: The co-gifters' shares add up to more than the total.
purchases_split_error_no_cost: Add a total cost to this gift before splitting it.
purchases_split_description: Set what each co-gifter put in. Your share is whatever’s left. Only you and your partner see this.
purchases_split_over_allocated: The co-gifters’ shares exceed the total. Lower them so your share isn’t negative.
received_intro: Gifts that have been archived on your lists. Once archived, you can see who gifted each item. Partnered gifters appear together as a single household.
received_empty: No received gifts yet. Items will appear here after they are archived.
received_empty_timeframe: No gifts received in this timeframe.
received_thank_you_description: A draft to get you started. Edit it so it sounds like you, then copy it into a card or open it in your email app. Nothing is sent from here.
received_thank_you_error_not_configured: Thank-you drafts are not set up on this site yet.
received_thank_you_error_not_found: Those gifts are no longer on your Received page. Refresh and try again.
received_thank_you_error_budget: AI features are paused for this month.
received_thank_you_error_rate_limited: That is a lot of drafts. Try again in a little while.
received_thank_you_error_failed: Could not write a draft just now. Try again.
